items.title: Go analyzer for resource bugs
items.oneliner: Static analyzer for Go that catches resource leaks and concurrency bugs missed by go vet in Docker-scale codebases.

items.title: Open workflow for product videos
items.oneliner: GitHub workflow that combines Playwright, FFmpeg, and narration tooling to generate polished product demo videos from real app flows.

items.title: Linux syscall tables and API
items.oneliner: Searchable Linux syscall reference with JSON exports across 27 architectures, useful for tracers, sandboxes, and low-level tooling.

items.title: Human-readable config format
items.oneliner: Config language that removes YAML ambiguity while keeping comments, typed values, and cleaner syntax than JSON.

items.title: Tor Browser 16 is available
items.oneliner: Stable Tor Browser release with redesigned settings, Firefox ESR 153 base, and more than 270 privacy and security fixes.

items.title: Tracker firmware source is open
items.oneliner: Firmware source and SDK for Polyend Tracker devices let developers build custom plugins, synths, themes, and instrument mods.

items.title: Interactive voxel city map
items.oneliner: Open interactive 3D voxel map of Warsaw that shows how to build browser-based spatial visualizations with real city data.

items.title: C64 dungeon crawler tutorial
items.oneliner: Hands-on BASIC tutorial adds levels, stairs, and character progression to a Commodore 64 dungeon crawler you can modify online.

items.title: Pure Blog customization walkthrough
items.oneliner: Step-by-step guide to extending Pure Blog with custom post types, hooks, and spam-resistant tweaks without forking the CMS.

items.title: Reverse engineering a car clock
items.oneliner: Detailed firmware hacking walkthrough for a Renault navigation unit, useful for learning embedded reverse engineering from a real bug.
